notes: All new routes are game adaptations. No new historical route provenance is asserted.
Doors pose art only. Movement, support, collision, interaction and visibility remain coder-owned.
Native1 x2 x.16 m walls and1 x1.65 x.12 m leaf bodies are never stretched; added top panels are explicit.
Use the listed source-part replacements and exact floor polygons together; raw asset directories stay unchanged.
End-gallery roof slopes are retained while their opaque flat underside caps are removed in the derivative, so stairs do not arrive below a false ceiling.
Terrace side approaches start on dry ground. The original central water stair remains a water-facing feature and is not a ground-access route.
Collision and floor-opening adapters preserve raw factories. Dry exterior ground is L0; the native waterfront terrace and its original aprons remain L1.
Stair support comes from actual exported tread top polygons, with no floor teleport.
